info.Title: Registration Certificates issued by DPIIT in accordance with DoE's order No. F.No.711O12021-PPD dated 23.02.2023

text: No.P-45018/6/2022-BE-11 (E-69546) Government of India Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Public Procurement Section) OFFICE MEMORANDUM Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated the 30th Apr, 2024 Sub: Registration Certificates issued by DPIIT in accordance with DoE's order No. F.No.7/10/2021-PPD dated 23.02.2023 - reg. This is in reference to Department of Expenditure Order (Public Procurement No. 4) No. F.No.7/10/2021-PPD dated 23.02.2023 under Rule 144 (xi) GFR, 2017 which stipulates that bidders from countries sharing land border with India will be eligible to bid in any public procurement only if the bidder is registered with Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). 2. In this regard , Registration Certificates issued by DPIIT may be accessed at DPIIT website under the Broad Head "Public Procurement" in the Subheading " Registration Granted under Rule 144 (xi) GFR" as well as at the following URL: https://dpiit.gov.in/registration-granted-under-rule-144xi-gfr. Fresh registration Certificates are uploaded on the aforementioned link on regular basis. 3. All Central Government Ministries/Departments and Chief Secretaries/Administrators of Union Territories/National Capital Territory of Delhi are requested to direct all procuring entities under their control to comply with the provisions of the DoE Order dated 23.02.2023 in letter and spirit in order to prevent any type of malicious instances wherever registration is legally required in accordance with DoE's said Order. It is also requested to verify the Registration Certificate of such bidders from the above mentioned URL before allowing them to participate in any public tender. 4. This issue with the approval of competent authority. ~\M~ \rR (Surendra Singh) Under Secretary to the Government of India E-mail: ssingh.dopt@nic.in Ph:- 011-23061592 To, 1.
